      <title>Toggl: Senior Full Stack</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/7274/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://toggl.com/jobs/">https://toggl.com/jobs/</a>
</p>

<div class="_descriptionText_5yu8i_201 ashby-job-posting-description">
<p>We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.</p>
<p>You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.</p>
<p>The salary for this position is&nbsp;<strong>€83,000 annually.</strong></p>
<p>You can work from anywhere in the world&nbsp;<strong>as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.</p>
<p>You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.</p>
<p>Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.</p>
<p>Your main responsibilities will be:</p>
<p><strong>Ownership and delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Craft and quality across the stack</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Working with product and design</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Raising the bar</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>AI as core leverage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>You will thrive in this role if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have deep, practical knowledge of&nbsp;<strong>JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS</strong>&nbsp;- including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does.&nbsp;<strong>Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role Is NOT</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA<br>team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your<br>tests, or own your performance regressions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Team</strong></p>
<p>We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/culture/">Our values</a>&nbsp;fuel our results.<br><br><strong>What's Happening at Toggl</strong></p>
<p>Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger:&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/focus/">Toggl 2.0</a>. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unlimited sick leave</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure</p>

      <title>Glean: Application Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Glean is looking for an experienced <strong>Application Security Engineer</strong> with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w"><span>Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.</span></li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).</span></li>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).</span>&nbsp;</li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.</span></li>
<li><span>Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></p>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen">&nbsp;</span></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0076/3373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, Arizona
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://adventuretravel365.com/">https://adventuretravel365.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web &amp; Mobile Platform</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a <strong>top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer</strong> to help us bring it to life.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think <strong>Thumbtack or Angi</strong>, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Help Us Build</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The platform will have two main sides: <strong>clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles</li>
<li>Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering</li>
<li>Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management</li>
<li>Job and project tracking</li>
<li>Client and vendor dashboards</li>
<li>Online payments and transaction tracking</li>
<li>Reviews and ratings</li>
<li>Notifications and communications</li>
<li>Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities</li>
<li>Admin tools for managing the platform</li>
<li>Reporting and analytics</li>
<li>Secure management of user, job, and transaction data</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to <strong>grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.</strong></p>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’d love to find someone with strong experience in <strong>full-stack web and mobile development</strong>, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-stack web development</li>
<li>Mobile or cross-platform app development</li>
<li>Strong front-end <strong>and</strong> back-end development</li>
<li>Multi-user marketplace platforms</li>
<li>User authentication and account management</li>
<li>Payment gateway integrations</li>
<li>Databases and APIs</li>
<li>Third-party integrations</li>
<li>Dashboards and reporting</li>
<li>Secure, scalable application architecture</li>
<li>Cloud hosting and deployment</li>
<li>Testing, maintenance, and optimization</li>
<li>Using modern <strong>AI-powered development tools</strong> and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">If you’ve worked on something similar to <strong>Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace</strong>, we definitely want to hear about it.</p>
<h2>More Than Just Coding</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also be expected to <strong>study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi</strong>, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be able to take the project through <strong>planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond</strong>, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important.</strong> You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is <strong>not a short-term build-and-leave project.</strong> We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.</p>
<h2>Interested? Tell Us About Yourself</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Please send us:</p>
<ul>
<li>A quick introduction</li>
<li>Your resume or LinkedIn profile</li>
<li>Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built</li>
<li>Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on</li>
<li>What <strong>you personally worked on</strong> for those projects</li>
<li>Your experience using AI in development</li>
<li>What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why</li>
<li>Your availability</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>A short video introduction would be great, too!</strong> Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.</p>
<p>Most importantly, <strong>show us what you’ve built.</strong> If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Cloud Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SF, NYC, or Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join Hex’s security team. You will be responsible for ensuring the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure, providing leadership in cloud security practices, and collaborating closely with our infrastructure and engineering teams to secure our cloud-native applications.</p>
<hr>
<h3>About the role:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design, implement, and manage security solutions and controls for AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters, including appropriate isolation/sandboxing methods for Hex’s RCE-as-a-Service platform</li>
<li>Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring robust security standards are enforced.</li>
<li>Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and audits on AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
<li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed security best practices into CI/CD pipelines.</li>
<li>Monitor and respond to cloud security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation actions.</li>
<li>Provide expertise in compliance requirements related to cloud security (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).</li>
<li>Mentor engineers and advocate for cloud security across the organization.</li>
</ul>
<h3>About you:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with extensive expertise in AWS.</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency with Kubernetes security including cluster hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and container vulnerability management.</li>
<li>Expert-level knowledge and hands-on experience with Terraform.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AWS security services (e.g., IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF).</li>
<li>Familiarity with CNAPP solutions such as Wiz</li>
<li>Familiarity with SIEM solutions such as Panther</li>
<li>Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD security, and DevSecOps methodologies.</li>
<li>Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), and Terraform Associate certification are highly desirable.</li>
<li>Bonus points for security certifications from SANS or OffSec.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>Our Engineering team</h3>
<p>We’re a group of engineers who are forging new ground together and love partnering with Security on our journey to pull ahead of our competition. You can read about how we think through problems as well as how we learn from mistakes on our blog here:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/we-took-down-production/">How we took down production…</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/beyond-linear-notebooks/">Beyond Linear Notebooks</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/a-pragmatic-approach-to-live-collaboration/">A pragmatic approach to live collaboration</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 class="Heading__HeadingInternal-sc-sir940-0 Heading___StyledHeadingInternal-sc-sir940-1 eQrUa-d">Our stack</h3>
<p>Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $198,750 - $295,000</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to.     LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.

    The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next.

    We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

     

    ","id":"926149ab-6999-4058-b35d-41e302b70e05","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Build and evolve the lakehouse: Help build the foundations that let data workflows read and write Iceberg tables directly, from this cycle's MVP to a production-grade platform.
  • Drive adoption: Help migrate data pipelines from across Spotify onto the new stack, making the move as painless as possible through tooling, standards and hands-on support.
  • Own BigQuery at Spotify scale: Manage reservations and capacity, build monitoring and anti-pattern detection, and develop tooling like the BigQuery MCP server so teams can use BigQuery well.
  • Keep the platform healthy: Take part in a weekly support rotation and shared on-call. You'll debug production issues that span storage formats, catalog APIs, Kubernetes reconciliation, GCP IAM and BigQuery internals, and you'll automate away recurring toil.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

  • You've worked with Apache Iceberg or JVM-based processing frameworks like Spark, Beam or Flink, or with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks.
  • You think in systems and can connect the dots when a problem crosses several layers of the stack.

    "}],"text":"Backend Engineer - Data Platform","country":"SE","workplaceType":"hybrid","opening":"","openingPlain":"","descriptionBody":"

    LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.

    The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively.     Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

     

    ","id":"186b763a-2a61-4563-8813-ff6b40c9c8a7","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Build and Evolve Core Services: Design, build and operate the backend services and APIs behind our data catalog, lineage and publishing systems, and evolve them as the platform adopts new storage technologies and new kinds of data. Hold them to a high bar for correctness, performance and reliability.
  • Build Data Pipelines: Develop and run the batch and streaming pipelines that keep our metadata current, processing platform events and audit logs to capture how data is created and changed, and turning lineage and metadata into data products other teams build on.
  • Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.
  • Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.

    The Music Mission enables music creators to grow, engage, and monetize their fan bases on Spotify. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artists and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos, and Clips help artists and their teams grow their audiences, connect with fans, and achieve their goals on Spotify.

    We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode within the Music Mission. Discovery Mode is a tool for artists and music marketers designed to help find new listeners when it matters most. With Discovery Mode, artists and labels identify songs that are a priority, and our systems use that signal to inform the algorithms that power personalized recommendations. This role sits within the ML squad that builds and operates the models behind Discovery Mode's measurement system, and you'll serve as the squad's analytical lead.

    In this role, you'll partner closely with product managers and ML engineers to evaluate and improve the models that power Discovery Mode.   • Detection & Mitigation: Review suspicious activity flagged by our fraud systems and take swift mitigating and preventative action to protect our genuine users, secure our growth, and minimize revenue leakage.

  • AI & Tooling Innovation: Actively utilize, test, and adopt emerging AI technologies and automated tooling to enhance fraud detection and improve operational productivity.

  • Build & Optimize: Partner closely with internal Product and Engineering teams as well as external vendors to help contribute to the design, requirement gathering, and testing of tooling and system changes to capture evolving fraud and abuse trends early.

  • Trend Analysis & Investigation: Be creative and proactively seek out new fraud and misuse trends. Present data-informed findings and retrospectives to suggest robust performance guardrails.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Handle daily fraud and misuse escalations while working closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to translate operational insights into risk mitigation frameworks.

  • Operational Excellence: Support the Revenue Protection leadership in maintaining and improving internal policies, process automation, evidence handling, and operational playbooks.

    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in a fraud analyst or revenue protection role, preferably within an e-commerce, merchant fraud, or creator & marketplace platform environment. Given the fixed-term nature of this role, the ability to rapidly adapt and hit the ground running is highly valued.

  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with common fraud prevention techniques, dispute/chargeback management, financial crime risks, and emerging industry trends.

  • AI & Systems Mindset: Direct experience working with machine learning and rule-based fraud prevention tooling (such as Ravelin, Sift, Signifyd, Accertify, etc.). You possess the confidence and curiosity to leverage AI technologies to test, scale, and optimize internal fraud detection tools.

  • Data Proficiency: Strong data analysis skills using SQL (knowledge of Google BigQuery is a plus) and experience with dashboard visualization tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Analytical Thinker: An ambitious and creative problem solver who works well independently, thrives when handling ambiguity, and can break down complex technical risks into practical applications.

  • Collaborator & Communicator: A highly communicative person with a collaborative mindset who excels at building strong relationships with internal stakeholders, operations, and global partners.

    We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow.

    Reporting to the Director, Global Experiential & Content Production, you'll play a key role in shaping the studio's creative output and how we work together.

    ","id":"25fac63d-d4ba-48b9-80b1-b8e87b55e448","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

    • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

    • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

    • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

    • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

    • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

    • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

    • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You bring 8+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong visual storytelling, brand identity, and motion design.

    • You have 4+ years of experience leading creative teams, with a thoughtful approach to coaching, feedback, and helping others develop their craft.

    • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

    • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

    • You know how to balance creative ambition with practical delivery, making thoughtful decisions around timelines, budgets, and resources.

    • You communicate creative ideas clearly and enjoy collaborating with designers, producers, and partners across different disciplines and regions.

    • You have experience working with external creative studios, production companies, and partners, including managing budgets, contracts, and production workflows.

    • You care about creating an inclusive, supportive team environment where different perspectives are valued, feedback is welcomed, and people can do their best work.

    "},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

    • This role is based in New York City.

    • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come into the office 1-2x per week.

    Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.

    We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers.     Working closely with local market teams and colleagues across Marketing, Product, Data, and Commercial, you'll turn growth opportunities into campaigns, experiments, and measurable results.     This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing ideas to life, learning through experimentation, and making things happen.   • Identify opportunities to improve acquisition, conversion, and retention by analysing listener behaviour, campaign performance, and subscription trends.
  • Partner with Marketing, Music, and local market teams to bring Premium to life through paid media, artist collaborations, cultural moments, and locally relevant campaigns.

  • Design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests across owned and paid channels, translating results into practical recommendations and future growth opportunities.
  • Work with Product, Data Science, and Payments teams to identify growth opportunities, test new capabilities, and build evidence that informs product priorities.

    Spotify's Legal team is growing. We're facing innovative challenges that mirror the groundbreaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we've expanded into more than 180 markets and our business has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day — including an increasing volume of patent disputes alongside the copyright and content matters that have always been central to our work.

    As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them. The work we face is constantly developing, and the workload is growing faster than we can, so we will look to you to think thoughtfully about processes and policies that will help meet our goals. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial. Significant e-discovery experience and experience conducting confidential inquiries are a plus.

    ","id":"8d54dd6d-d7e0-4298-b051-423bcec4089e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.
  • Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes.
  • Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives.
  • Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment.
  • Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation.
  • Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others.
  • Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement.
  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You hold a law degree (or equivalent) from a top-flight law school and are qualified to practice law as in-house counsel in the State of New York.
  • You have 5+ years of litigation experience at a law firm, in-house, or both, including meaningful experience with copyright litigation.
  • You have experience with e-discovery and managing complex, multi-jurisdictional disputes.
  • You have experience contributing to teams that drive successful outcomes on complex matters.
  • You have a demonstrated ability to evaluate copyright claims, work with technical experts, and develop defense strategies.
  • You have a passion for solving legal problems and can explain legal concepts — including technical copyright issues — to non-lawyers.
  • You are comfortable working with large data sets and technical subject matter; you may not be an engineer, but you can speak the language and understand the concepts.
  • You are a problem solver who can stay calm when problems come your way.
  • You have excellent judgment — you can think a problem through when you need to, but have also developed instincts that you can trust.
  • You are self-motivated and can identify and complete work that needs to be done without being instructed.
  • You can advocate for a position while balancing risk and multiple colleagues' and business considerations.
  • You can balance many simultaneous tasks and triage to make sure the right matters get your attention.
  • You're willing to roll up your sleeves and dig in on projects.
  • You work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal business partners.
  • You have very effective written and oral communication skills.
  • Knowledge of music, media, tech, IP, and/or consumer issues is a plus.
  • A technical background or experience with software, streaming, or audio technology patents is a plus but not required.

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve reporting for the partnership portfolio, including KPIs, performance tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and tooling to help Spotify evaluate and manage partnerships more effectively.

    You’ll bring a strong understanding of video, podcasts, and the broader creator ecosystem. You’ll combine creator relationships, data, and sound judgment to help shape how Spotify supports creators across Lifestyle & Wellness, with a particular focus on Fitness.

    ","id":"a6f8c9a6-821e-45d9-85c8-e5783ec03eaf","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Manage relationships with a portfolio of Spotify creators across Lifestyle & Wellness, helping them grow their presence and audiences on Spotify.

    • Support the growth of Fitness on Spotify by identifying, recruiting, and onboarding high-value and high-potential creators and video content.

    • Develop a deep understanding of creators’ businesses and goals, connecting them with Spotify products, programs, and opportunities that can deliver meaningful value.

    • Use performance data and audience insights to advise creators on content strategy, audience development, and opportunities for growth.

    • Help shape Spotify’s creator strategy and partner approach for Fitness by bringing forward creator insights, opportunities, and ideas as the space evolves.

    • Develop and test new ways to support and engage creators, identifying successful approaches that can scale across the broader creator ecosystem.

    • Collaborate with teams across Spotify to support priority creators, increase adoption of relevant products and features, and advance partner and company initiatives.

    • Bring creator feedback, portfolio trends, and quantitative and qualitative insights back into Spotify to help inform content and product strategy.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 5+ years of partner-facing experience in creator or talent relations, account management, business development, or a related field within an audio, video, social, talent management, or creator-focused organization.

    The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

    Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale.

    You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.

    • Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time.
    • Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales.
    • Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
    • Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience.
    • Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users.
    • Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.

    We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

    • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
    • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
    • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
    • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

    ","id":"0eebb462-b5a2-4e3a-b830-d8ef7505b014","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
    Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
     
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
     
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
     
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
     
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

     

    Security engineers at Spotify protect our platform, employees, creators, and more than 700 million users. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Detection and Response organization and help identify, investigate, and respond to threats across Spotify's environment.

     

    You will work within our detection engineering squad where the team owns alert triage, security investigations, threat hunting, and the detection engineering lifecycle. You will turn threat intelligence, incident learnings, and analyst feedback into effective detections and investigation workflows. You will partner closely with the detection infrastructure squad, which builds and operates Detection and Response platforms and telemetry pipelines, and with teams across Spotify to make sure your squad has the signals and capabilities needed to detect and respond to threats at Spotify's scale.

     

    We are a distributed team that values curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous learning. We teach and learn from one another, adapt as the threat landscape changes, and focus our effort according to business needs and risk.

    ","id":"cb29d857-395b-401d-9749-367e666ff870","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available.

    • Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments.

    • Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation.

    • Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response.

    • Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence.

    • Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight.

    • Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload.

    • Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes.

    • Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

    • You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, detection engineering, or closely related work.

    • You understand how analysts triage and investigate alerts and how detection quality affects their decisions and workload.

    • You know how to create and tune detections based on attacker behavior, available telemetry, and an expected investigation path.

    • You are experienced with security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or comparable monitoring and response technologies.

    • You can write code or use an automation platform to analyze security telemetry, enrich alerts, build investigation workflows, and remove repetitive work. Experience with Python or a similar language is valuable.

    • You understand modern detection-as-code practices, including GitHub, peer review, CI/CD, testing, and safely managing production detection content.

    • You have experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.

    • You understand common threats affecting SaaS-oriented corporate and production environments.

    • You care about clear documentation, inclusive collaboration, and explaining security concepts to people with different backgrounds and levels of expertise.

    • You are excited to create and critically evaluate cutting-edge AI workflows for detection development, alert triage, security investigations, and response, while applying sound security judgment and appropriate human oversight.

  • You have a solid understanding of the risks introduced by agentic AI in an enterprise context and you are keen to get hands-on identifying and mitigating these risks in our environment.

    We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.

    You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.

    ","id":"9d1c90b5-a8a4-4218-b2f3-7bbaefae7fd1","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
  • Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
  • Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
  • Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
  • Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
  • Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
  • Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
  • Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
  • Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.
  • You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.
  • You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.
  • You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.
  • You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.
  • You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
  • You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.
  • You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.
  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.
  • You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.
  • You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

    • Own the artist and partner flywheel for Premium growth, evolving artist advocacy, fan experiences, and partnership programs toward measurable Premium outcomes.

    • Shape and execute the Premium opportunity within existing in-person activations, including film partnerships, bespoke music events, festivals, and other relevant cultural moments.

    • Partner with local Music & Podcasts, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to identify and activate artists, creators, and partners that can help grow Premium.

    • Design and run desirability initiatives with clear success metrics, using performance data and audience behaviour to understand what works and continuously improve the strategy.

    • Own the fandom value opportunity for Premium end-to-end, from identifying opportunities to partnering with Product on fan-facing Premium features and experiences.

    • Develop business cases and evaluate the impact of desirability, artist, and partner initiatives to inform where we invest and scale.

    • Capture and share learnings that strengthen the India Premium Growth playbook, contribute to cross-regional Growth initiatives, and support adjacent growth priorities when business needs require it.

    • Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.

    Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.

Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.

    As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

     
    ","id":"c3f6ea23-97d0-4a9a-a9ad-04f1e745d916","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.
  • You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics.
  • You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights.
  • You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.
  • You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.
  • You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time.
  • You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.
  • You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

    Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks.

    This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

    ","id":"e04833c0-9cff-4b5e-b217-91a3bcb57051","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do:","content":"

    • Design, build, deploy, and operate scalable backend services that power authorization, permissions, and team management across Spotify.

    • Take ownership of critical systems that enable creators, teams, agents, licensors, and other partners to securely access and manage the right content and capabilities.

    • Evolve our backend architecture to support continued growth in users, use cases, and Spotify products while maintaining high standards for reliability, performance, and security.

    • Improve the systems and workflows that enable creators to gain access to their content, profiles, and teams.

    • Make thoughtful technical decisions and trade-offs, balancing long-term architecture with solutions that meet current product and business needs.

    • Partner with engineers and cross-functional collaborators across Spotify to understand authorization needs and build reusable platform capabilities.

    • Contribute to frontend experiences and data-related work when useful, while bringing deep expertise and leadership to backend engineering.

    We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

    The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is understood, trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform.

    As the scale and diversity of content continue to grow—driven by advances in AI, new creation tools, and emerging content formats—we’re investing in intelligent systems that can understand, evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale.

    We’re hiring Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineers to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and decisioning across Spotify. Depending on your experience and interests, you may focus on areas ranging from multimodal content understanding and platform-level ML systems to safety, risk detection, policy enforcement, and compliance.

    You’ll help shape the architecture and technical strategy behind how Spotify understands and makes decisions about content at global scale. This work is foundational to delivering safe, high-quality experiences for listeners and creators while enabling new ways for people to interact with content across Spotify.

Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.

    As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

    ","id":"281e7db9-86ba-4a1c-8773-c23b96ed32dc","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.

    • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.

    • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.

    • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

    • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

    • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

    • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

    • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

    • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.
